checks.name: Backend verify incl. OrderPlacementIntegrationTest (PostgreSQL, concurrency, injected failure)
Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and registry parity

scenario_results.observed: OrderPlacementIntegrationTest: a test-only trigger raises an error on the outbox insert (after the stock update) for this kitchen; the request returns 500 INTERNAL_ERROR without the internal message and leaves no order, allocation, reserved counter, cash obligation or idempotency record; after dropping the trigger the same key and clientRequestId complete once (one order, reserved 2).

The same key and body replays the original order (same id); after deleting the cached idempotency records (retention elapsed) the same key, and a new key with the same clientRequestId, both return the same order; exactly one order, one event and reserved=1 remain; the recovery lookup by clientRequestId returns it and an unknown reference is 404. A mutation removing the permanent clientRequestId check failed the test.

The same key with another body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; the same clientRequestId with another quote is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; reusing a quote for another request is 409 QUOTE_ALREADY_USED; the original order keeps its version and item and reserved stays 1.

One portion left and 20 distinct verified customers each holding a valid quote place concurrently: exactly one 201 and nineteen 409 STOCK_CHANGED; slot and meal reserved counters are 1, one order and allocations summing to 1. A mutation removing the row locks failed the test.

Persistent idempotency plus permanent clientRequestId; deterministic stock locks; order, item (meal revision snapshot, unaffected by later meal edits/archiving), address and contact snapshots; reservation, PLACED event, ORDER_PLACED outbox (no personal data) and DUE cash obligation of 35000 in one transaction; commission snapshot 10% of subtotal excluding delivery; stale/expired/foreign/unaccepted quotes and forged fields refused with no stock change; owner-only order, events and list (other customer 404), ACTIVE/PAST paging, recovery lookup.

findings: Self-review defect fixed: when the database had already aborted the transaction, the idempotency cleanup threw and masked the original failure; the original is now rethrown with the cleanup error suppressed.

Self-review: contract listed a cursor parameter for events that the server does not use; removed (paging by afterSequence). The optional Idempotent-Replay response header in the contract is not emitted yet.

Residual: outbox delivery worker, cook queues, lifecycle commands, expiry scheduler and handover codes are MB-019; cash collection/verification and commission posting are finance stories (MB-020/MB-025).
Residual: the race test runs 20 concurrent requests in one JVM against one PostgreSQL instance; load testing at pilot volume is a P08 activity.
